scope: Single RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, existing Qwen3.8 GSQ, public Engine. Three explicit profiles on one final binary; measured Engine phase timing, not API TTFT or component attribution.

model.identity_note: Existing registered artifact selected by explicit name and byte size; full model was not rehashed for this publication.

build_toolchain.scope: Compiler versions and target settings recorded by this final build; CUDA driver field above is the driver API version, not a driver package version.

A.description: Explicit conservative fallback on the same v1.0.0 binary; not product defaults or an old release

C.description: R29 MTP15 performance profile; context-specific option

method.output_count_note: One initial output from prefill plus 128 decode outputs. Decode throughput uses 128, not 129. Warmup and measured output arrays are checked equal per process.
method.timing_scope: Engine-reported prefill_seconds and decode_seconds. Weight load/upload, Graph prime, warmup and process setup are outside those measured phases. Process wall is retained only as a receipt.
method.pairing: Within each triple compare B/A, C/B and C/A using its own measured durations. No cross-round median addition or multiplication.
method.paired_median: Median of the three within-triple percentage changes, computed separately per comparison and phase.
method.absolute_profile_median: Median of three raw phase durations and median of three per-run token/s rates. Ratio of these profile medians generally differs from median paired percentage.

initial_attempt.outcome: First candidate K15 Graph process failed at startup after successful eager semantic validation

graph_and_math_history.fix: Only topologyChanged update failures instantiate a replacement executable before retiring the old executable. Other CUDA errors remain errors.
graph_and_math_history.final_graph_evidence: All 18 fresh final-binary Graph Engine processes exit0 and pass full output checks.

inherited_numerical_qualification.scope: Previously completed numerical qualification is inherited because Ops/GGML/Engine archives and arithmetic owners are unchanged; only Core topology replacement and software version metadata changed. Graph/output equivalence is additionally established by the final 18 runs; no repeated oracle run is claimed.

conclusions.B_over_A: At 4K and 32K, all three prefill pairs improve. Short decode is mixed; long decode all three pairs improve.
conclusions.C_over_B: 32K decode improves in all three pairs, paired median +10.219625903274231%; 4K decode regresses in all three pairs, paired median -15.183451489829691%.
conclusions.profile_selection: Use B/MTP7 for the measured short workload; C/MTP15 is a context-specific option for the measured 32K workload, not a universal replacement.
not_claimed: original213K quality conclusion within this performance artifact
conclusions.quality_scope: Original six-request quality is published separately; full benchmark token equality is not a substitute for that gate.

provenance.packaging: Only derived scalar records and benchmark-generated token IDs are included; no weights, tensor dumps, binaries, caches, logs or CPU row-sum oracles.
